_comment: Clips committed to this repository, named by the hash VoiceService looks up. Built by tools/bake_voice_bank.gd; do not edit by hand.

0a40313ce730a1ca2f478e99b417b40936d7883e.speaker: Aldric
0a40313ce730a1ca2f478e99b417b40936d7883e.text: Six days. Nobody's walked the river bank past the willows.

2a2d8b7a8a6254e9195d424f5cbe91e9f7cad0de.speaker: Maud
2a2d8b7a8a6254e9195d424f5cbe91e9f7cad0de.text: Old coin. What sort of man carries his grandfather's money and won't say his own name?

364c78dde76be00a4e35de8da27c4f84d6041ea4.speaker: Aldric
364c78dde76be00a4e35de8da27c4f84d6041ea4.text: Three nights back, that. Same road the willows run along.

3879d65abf810f7f37b561bbad4f6d8dcfa0ac14.speaker: Maud
3879d65abf810f7f37b561bbad4f6d8dcfa0ac14.text: And you'll have it, and a loaf besides.

4293e98dc738a98c10da4a0ff6db7d04ecc98dec.speaker: Serjeant Hale
4293e98dc738a98c10da4a0ff6db7d04ecc98dec.text: I want a good deal of things, Corwin.

4d159759a5cf69487960ab364ba61c7d779e5eaa.speaker: Corwin
4d159759a5cf69487960ab364ba61c7d779e5eaa.text: Then have a drink while you want them.

5d008bd6d0c9434f5a485c645af00623d3be1820.speaker: Father Brannoc
5d008bd6d0c9434f5a485c645af00623d3be1820.text: You came because you cannot leave it alone. Nor can I.

b94a5f7dc66841313fe4494a523808ea6a03c94e.speaker: Aldric
b94a5f7dc66841313fe4494a523808ea6a03c94e.text: He gave no name and I didn't ask for one. He paid, and his coin was older than me.

c0d590c97023f944c348705b7fb29fb6d74b3232.speaker: Father Brannoc
c0d590c97023f944c348705b7fb29fb6d74b3232.text: You needn't have come down the hill for this.

c619536aa2aef896dde1412d41546c4a3aac3176.speaker: Corwin
c619536aa2aef896dde1412d41546c4a3aac3176.text: You'll want the ledger straight before he comes.

e62f2d8269510e303a2e9adeb5eab79a5ba481b0.speaker: Wenna
e62f2d8269510e303a2e9adeb5eab79a5ba481b0.text: I came for the air, Father.

e6e14bfc167e4c17e0072171f375b3243931c88a.speaker: Aldric
e6e14bfc167e4c17e0072171f375b3243931c88a.text: Irons cost what they cost, Maud.

f06ca77de5f82be96b7caa448a81633eeded79e4.speaker: Aldric
f06ca77de5f82be96b7caa448a81633eeded79e4.text: The sort who pays. That's more than I can say for some standing here.
